name: DishChannelWetPerimeter
comment: Returns the wetted perimeter of a parabolic dish channel, the arc length of the parabola through (0, 0), (Width/2, -Height), and (Width, 0). Argument order is Width, then Height. Width is the top chord and Height is the depth below that chord. Width 0 or Height 0 returns #DIV/0!. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
